// Item 3 fixture (MATRICES § D, receiver aliases; § G, Q3: R-AFF, R-PARAM, R-CTX and transmission).
// Each case is copied as a new file into a scanned tree of a temporary copy by tests/l0-pi-surface.test.ts.

// ── case: aff ──
export default function (api: any): void {
  const API = api as unknown;
  (API as any).registerTool({});
}

// ── case: param ──
import type { ExtensionAPI } from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";
function aide(x: ExtensionAPI): void {
  x.exec("true", []);
}
export default function (api: ExtensionAPI): void {
  aide(api);
}

// ── case: ctx ──
export default function (api: any): void {
  api.on("session_start", (_e: unknown, ctx: any) => {
    const vue = ctx.ui;
    vue.notify("épreuve", "info");
  });
}

// ── case: homonyme ──
export default function (api: any): void {
  const API = api;
  API.registerTool({});
  function ailleurs(): void {
    const API = { autre(): void {} };
    API.autre();
  }
  ailleurs();
}

// ── case: homonyme-sans-masque ──
export default function (api: any): void {
  const API = api;
  API.registerTool({});
  function ailleurs(): void {
    API.autre();
  }
  ailleurs();
}

// ── case: transmission-non-annotee ──
function aideLibre(x: unknown): void {
  void x;
}
export default function (api: any): void {
  aideLibre(api);
}

// ── case: transmission-position ──
import type { ExtensionAPI } from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";
function aideDeux(n: unknown, x: ExtensionAPI): void {
  void n;
  x.exec("true", []);
}
export default function (api: ExtensionAPI): void {
  aideDeux(api, 1 as any);
}

// ── case: stockage ──
export default function (api: any): object {
  return { api };
}

// ── case: valeur ──
export default function (api: any): unknown {
  return api;
}
